 Updated: 10:20 AM EST Nov 13, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Randi Rico WLWT News 5 TODAY Meteorologist CINCINNATI — WLWT Weather Chat is now available to provide personalized weather forecasts for Cincinnati residents. 
 So when you’re on the go, your weather questions don’t have to wait. 
 Advertisement Click here to explore the new WLWT weather chat tool 
 By entering your town or ZIP code, you can receive a personalized forecast and answers to your weather questions.
 The tool uses forecast data from WLWT's trusted weather team, led by Chief Meteorologist Kevin Robinson. The tool uses generative AI and can make mistakes, do not rely on it for safety reasons.
 WLWT Weather Chat is now accessible on WLWT.com.
